summary.en-US: Crate's look for Firefox: a near-black canvas, hairlines instead of filled boxes and one cyan accent.

description.en-US:
The look of Crate (https://cratemusic.app), the self-hosted music app, on Firefox: the frame, tabs and toolbars sit on Crate's near-black canvas, the selected tab and the focused address bar carry a thin cyan line, menus and panels are drawn in Crate's popover colour with hairline borders, and Firefox's own pages open dark.

It is a colour theme only: no permissions, no scripts, no data collected.

Part of Crate for Ryoku (https://github.com/thecrateapp/crate-for-ryoku), which can also give Firefox Crate's fonts and 6 px corners through userChrome.css.
